Q5735.reason: Only a defendant may remove under 28 U.S.C. §1441(a), so the plaintiff's removal was improper and the court will remand the entire case.

Q5750.reason: The concern is access: most people over 65 lack internet access, so internet-only sources would miss much of that group, though the specific 30% figure is likely dated.

Q5130.reason: An arterial pulsation does not change with posture, whereas venous pulsation does; the other options describe venous features.
